about: Every Elden Ring system the mod touches. Each row is one module in the DLL. 'api' names the fromsoftware-rs item or the RE target.

columns.api: fromsoftware-rs type/function, or what must be reverse engineered
columns.source: crate (exists in fromsoftware-rs 0.14) or re (we must find it)

rows.system: wait for the game window and a fresh reflection scan, then start tasks
clone and tune Bullet/AtkParam/SpEffect rows in memory
rows.api: SoloParamRepository::get_mut<AtkParam_Pc> via Bullet.atk_id_bullet; bullets spawned with goods_id 1700 (Throwing Dagger) so flat atk applies

rows.system: fire ability bullets so the engine does hits
apply/remove fighter stat profiles and buffs

move the player for dashes, blitzes, leaps, dives, double jump, air dash and slide: per-frame steps from the current position (motion.rs), so crossing a map block doesn't throw the player across the map
rows.api: CSChrPhysicsModule.position + chr_proxy_pos_update_requested, gravity_disabled; Havok ray casts for walls and ground

rows.system: play an Elden Ring animation on the player for each ability
rows.api: CSChrEventModule.request_animation_id: tried in 0.3.0, the game ignores it (lab trace); abilities use motion, effects and impact freezes instead

rows.system: know when the player is hit (Awakening gauge)
rows.api: poll ChrIns HP delta + last_hit_by each frame

rows.system: ability buttons on keyboard, mouse and controller without the game also reacting; rebindable in the Controls page
rows.api: DirectInput GetDeviceState + XInputGetState detours; chords hidden inside the XInput hook from the same pad state the game reads

rows.system: open the Elden Force menu at a Site of Grace
fighter select, grace menu, Ki/Awakening HUD
equip a fighter's vanilla armor look
play Elden Force's own shouts (voices.bin) and music (jumpring/audio: menu, exploring, boss themes, the Burning of the Erdtree)
rows.api: cridecoder (MIT) AFS2 + HCA decode in-process, rodio playback

rows.system: separate save so the player's vanilla save is never touched
rows.api: rewrite the single UTF-16 .sl2 literal in eldenring.exe memory to .jr2 at boot; seed ER0000.jr2 from ER0000.sl2 once

rows.system: mod log the agent reads after each run
fighter movement: 1.5x running/jumps, 1.5x faster dodges, double jump, air dash, slide
moves home on the nearest enemy in front when nothing is locked on
